jobs.title: Copy Editor
jobs.description: About Legal 500 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients. Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms. We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol. Freelance Copy Editor Remote | £5.20 per editorial | Contract until February 2027 About the opportunity We’re looking for experienced freelance Copy Editors to support our EMEA research and editorial team during a busy part of our publication cycle. You’ll review and refine written assessments produced by our researchers, helping to ensure that our editorial content is accurate, consistent and easy to read. This is a fully remote freelance opportunity, suited to someone who is comfortable working independently, managing a high volume of content and delivering work to fixed deadlines. Making light edits to address significant grammar, clarity or house-style issues. Proofreading matter summaries and key client lists submitted by law firms. jobs.title: Working Student – Research for Content (m/f/d)
jobs.description: How much house can people afford? Can we construct an index to show the trend? What is happening to household density? Are government subsidies on retirement savings well spent? With AI eroding the usefulness of light content, we are focussing more and more on the complex questions people need answers to. As a Working Student – Research for Content (m/f/d) you will actively help us gain deeper insights that support people making smarter decisions about their financial future, notably property purchasing and investments for retirement. You will work directly with our CFO, an ex-IMF/World Bank PhD economist, and a great team of people to support our mission with research that can be used for content and to attract interest. This research can cover the property market, the tax system for housing and other investments, and how retirement savings are supported. As a company, we make complex topics simple, and good research fits this by zeroing in on what matters and delivering razor-sharp analysis and conclusions. Does that sound enticing? Then apply now and join a team that enjoys exploring such questions. About us More generally, we are a great team that supports one another, learns from each other, and uses data to make informed decisions. We are highly motivated and deeply committed to our customers. We aim to leverage the best technology to deliver optimal results and uncover new insights. We are looking for working students who want to help challenge the status quo. Curious? Here’s what we’re looking for Your Responsibilities 💬 Conduct research with a focus on real, usable output. 🙌 Feel comfortable working with market data, economic or financial insights. 🧑‍💻 Help us create new and relevant insights, that get us the attention of users and AI bots. Your Profile 📚 You are an enrolled student in an economics, finance, or related field. 😊 You are inquisitive, curious to explore data to support insights, and ideally can point to some projects you did before. 🖥️
